title: The Signature Professional Certification Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Certification requirements, examination details, costs, and renewal rules. The Professional Certification Database records certifications with eligibility requirements, examination format and content outlines, published costs, renewal cycles, and continuing-education requirements from the certifying body's official pages. Records note which certifications employers actually request. The Signature side adds study timelines built from the official content outlines.
capabilities: Record certifications with requirements and exam details
Document costs, renewal cycles, and continuing education
Link to official certifying-body pages
Note employer demand per certification
Build study timelines from content outlines
